title: Certify that the fragmentation of the #4610 word is rigid under free scalar reordering (negative result, no new kappa)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

## Change and mathematical scope

**Negative result, no new κ, no changed selected record.** Adds `research/fragmentation-reorder-rigidity`. #5226 prices the whole gap between Cao Yifan's #4610 word and the +0.05 % bar as fragmentation loss Λ = 23.86 per call and asks which scalar-program changes can merge climbs; #4993 and #4610's own MILP re-chose frames at a fixed chronological order; #4610 lists a changed chronological order as open. This package frees the order: scalar operations may be rescheduled anywhere their value dependencies allow (ADDs into one destination commute; write/read and write/write conflicts are kept; the `zero_frame_precondition`, `full_frame_cleanup` and `done` markers are barriers; warps stay anchored between their two frames), all 632 frame chains and all contact frames are re-chosen jointly under the retained contract (nested chains, one common frame per ADD inside `S_d + S_s ≤ F ≤ T_d ∩ T_s`, the field at the frame of every C0 contact), and the eight owned-centre reads may move along their source chains.

Exact certificate (`verify.py`, standard library, about 2 minutes): for every one of the 2,526 droppable intermediate levels (the 12 frame-revisiting fields and the warp frames excluded), **every admissible re-routing of its contacts is enumerated (518,315 in all) and tested by an exact acyclicity check of the operation/level graph (Pearce–Kelly dynamic order). No level can be dropped at a gain**: 322 levels have no admissible re-routing, 2,196 close a cycle under every re-routing, and the 8 remaining levels are the centre-read levels themselves, droppable only by reading the centre in the full frame (transport rank 9 instead of 8, +0.983 per call). The fragmentation of #4610 is therefore a property of its operation set and centre interface, not of its schedule. Supporting census: endpoints alone force 12 of 2,754 levels, the partners' exact chains force 2,437, the dependency DAG has critical path 694 of 18,159 operations. What Λ would buy (kap-family formula of #5226): word 0.0030217759 (p16 a7); mains one climb each 0.0037103 (p13); helpers one climb each 0.0051074 (p9); Λ = 0 **0.0081386 (p5 a2)**.

Status: finite exact certificate on the frozen word (operation set, coefficients, native maps, endpoints fixed) for single-level merges; multi-step moves were explored by 37 million recorded annealing moves only (`search/`, not replayed). It is not a floor for the family. Remaining obligations: none for this claim.

## Task and overlap

Base `1a3ced60b2f7a46bc70280a04f2eeb8ca027c700` (current main, selected PR5413). Inputs pinned by SHA256: `research/kappa-round3-warp-20261022/ACTUAL-WORD.json.gz`, `ARITHMETIC.json`. Task card `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision 7, scope **changed** (recorded in `TASK.json`): instead of synthesizing a block-climb decoder, the package asks exactly whether rescheduling can coarsen the climbs of the current word. Nearest work and added value: #5226 (`fragmentation-ceiling`: Λ, ship test, kap formula reused), #4993 and #4610's MILP (frames at fixed order), `cao-trace-retiming-20261023` (ADD compression at fixed chronology; its bounded searches keep the scalar order), `fusion-pair-scalar-rewiring` (#5422: no consecutive rank-1 pair fusable by free rewiring with frames fixed), `owned-centre-wire-floor` (#5060: why the delivery frame stays 0). None frees the chronological order or enumerates the joint re-routings; a check of open PRs and discussions on 2026-10-24 found no package on reordering.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/fragmentation-reorder-rigidity/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/fragmentation-reorder-rigidity/test_verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/fragmentation-reorder-rigidity
```

Marker `PASS_FRAGMENTATION_REORDER_RIGIDITY`; the registered runner prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE … outcome=negative-result` locally (CPython 3.12, Windows). `verify.py` pins both inputs, rebuilds the word model (climb profile + 8 centre jobs = `ARITHMETIC.local_paid`, Λ = 23.8626 at the word's root), runs the enumeration and compares `RESULT.json` exactly. Controls: ignoring the centre interface makes the same enumeration find 51 improving drops (the test is live); `test_verify.py` rejects a drifted input hash, a corrupted climb rank, a contact frame mismatch and a tampered result. Pruning used in the enumeration is the necessary condition that an operation which must precede another cannot sit at a higher frame of the same field. Not run: Lean, native/phase/compiler replays, hosted CI; no word is proposed, so no admission.

Prepared by Mark (Matarener) with substantial Claude Code (Claude) assistance. Apache-2.0; author-checked, not independent acceptance.

## Open next questions

`TASK.json`: (1) a skeleton-free fragmentation floor for the #4610 endpoint identity (first step: the chain-cover LP over the contact hypergraph with free frames; the one-field relaxations force nothing, so a floor must use the joint chains and the centre interface); (2) the same enumeration on the ADD-compressed word of `cao-trace-retiming-20261023` (fewer contacts may unpin levels; blocked by taking that word as a frozen input); (3) a changed centre delivery frame is a changed mechanism, outside this package.
